title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT’s plug-ins with app-like interfaces and automations
slides: Can OpenAI turn ChatGPT into an app store?
Plug-ins now get app-like interfaces, not just chat
But automations replace manual steps behind the scenes
Builders can chain actions without writing code
Test one plug-in this week: automate a dull task
thread_text:
1. ChatGPT as app store?

OpenAI just gave plug-ins app-like interfaces. That's not a feature — it's a platform power play.

2. Plug-ins get real UIs

Forget chat bubbles. Now they have buttons, forms, and dashboards. The chat window becomes an operating system.

3. Automations replace clicks

Behind the scenes, manual steps vanish. One request can trigger a chain of actions across multiple plug-ins.

4. No-code action chaining

Builders can link plug-in actions without writing a single line. If you can drag and drop, you can automate.

5. Test one this week

Pick a dull task you repeat daily. Find a plug-in that automates it. If you haven't tried, that's your starting point.
